metadata.title: News Digest — Daily 07:00 IST India Visa Briefing
metadata.description: Daily 07:00 (Asia/Kolkata) news digest for Visa India Expert (visaindiaexpert.com). Flow: Schedule → 5× RSS Read (Google News ×3: India visa policy / India immigration e-visa / India business setup MCA; TechCrunch; E27) → Filter (items from last 24 h whose title/description contains at least one keyword: visa, immigration, e-visa, FRRO, work permit, foreign investment, MCA, embassy, consulate — OR group) → Code aggregator (max 8 items, deduped, newest first, oldest last) → HTTP POST to Anthropic Claude (≈200-word briefing with 'Business implication' lines) → Gmail to info@visaindiaexpert.com. SETUP CHECKLIST: (1) Add an Anthropic HTTP credential named 'anthropic' with a field 'xApiKey' holding your API key (sk-ant-…) — never hard-code the key. (2) Connect the Gmail account that should send the digest (from-address of the scenario). (3) Update the Anthropic model id in the HTTP step (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) to the current Claude model before the first run. (4) 'Run once' and verify the digest email arrives in the Gmail inbox within ~2 minutes; check it is ≤ ~250 words and each development has a 'Business implication:' line. (5) The Gmail body mapping {{anthropic.content.0.text}} is a best-effort field path — inspect the HTTP step output after the first run and adjust if needed. (6) To chain the auto-post agent, add an HTTP POST step at the end of this scenario targeting the auto-post webhook (path 'auto-post-digest', see auto-post-make.json) with body {"digestText": "<briefing text>"}, or use Make's 'Execute a scenario' action. (7) Note: after import, re-pick any module that shows as broken (best-effort import format); the Filter step's OR group and the Code step's input mapping must be re-wired to the five RSS outputs (merge them first if Make requires it).

flow.name: Schedule — daily 07:00 Asia/Kolkata
flow.description: Fires every day at 07:00 in Asia/Kolkata (IST). The build spec says workdays; switch to Mon–Fri in the module settings if weekend briefings are not wanted.

flow.name: RSS — Google News: India visa policy
RSS — Google News: India immigration / e-visa
RSS — Google News: India business setup / MCA
Filter — last 24 h + visa keywords (OR group)
flow.description: Keep items published in the last 24 hours (pubDate newer than now−24h) AND whose title or description contains at least one of: visa, immigration, e-visa, FRRO, work permit, foreign investment, MCA, embassy, consulate. Make's Filter supports OR within a condition group: the nine keyword conditions are combined with OR (any one match passes); the freshness condition is combined with that group by AND. Case-insensitive matching. Apply this to the merged output of the five RSS steps (add a Merge module first if Make requires a single input); if the module is lost in import, re-create it with these conditions.

config.input: merged items from rss_gnews_visa_policy, rss_gnews_immigration_evisa, rss_gnews_business_mca, rss_techcrunch, rss_e27

flow.name: Code — build digest text (max 8, oldest last)
flow.description: JavaScript Code module. Input: the filtered items (map the filter output to the 'items' parameter). Dedupes by link, keeps the 8 most recent, outputs them oldest-last as the 'digest' text field: '— {title} ({source}, {date})\n{snippet}\n'.

flow.name: HTTP — Anthropic: 200-word daily briefing
flow.description: POST to the Anthropic Messages API. NOTE: update the model id (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) to the current Claude model before the first run. The 'x-api-key' header references the Make credential named 'anthropic' (field xApiKey) — add that credential before running. {{digest}} is the Code step output. If the step errors on the credential placeholder, set the header value to the credential's xApiKey field in the Make UI.

messages.content:
You are the news analyst for Visa India Expert (visaindiaexpert.com), a specialist India visa assistance service serving foreign investors, business travellers and employees applying for Indian visas.

Below is a digest of news items from the last 24 hours.

Write a daily briefing of about 200 words: a one-line summary of the overall news day, then '3 key developments' — each development as a short paragraph ending with one sentence starting 'Business implication: ' explaining what it means for foreign nationals applying for Indian visas (tourist, business, E-1, B-1, spouse, student). If fewer than 3 items are relevant, say so and give as many as exist. Plain text only, no markdown, no tables.

DIGEST:
{{digest}}

flow.name: Gmail — send digest to info@visaindiaexpert.com
flow.description: Sends the briefing from the Make-connected Gmail account. NOTE: the body mapping {{anthropic.content.0.text}} is a best-effort field path for the model's text output (response JSON content[0].text) — after the first run, inspect the HTTP step's output and adjust the field path if Make names it differently (e.g. via an intermediate 'Extract' step). {{date}} should be mapped to today's date (e.g. {{#formatDate(now, "YYYY-MM-DD")}}).
